task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-07 at src/design/adp-07-agent-role-reserved-usernames.md. Define additive role and identity semantics that introduce AGENT_RUNNER as a grantable role while preserving existing role behavior. Specify reserved username policy for prefix agent:, including enforcement boundaries that reject creation by non-PLATFORM_ADMIN actors and allow PLATFORM_ADMIN creation. Define compatibility requirements for existing users/roles, role-assignment flows, API/validation touchpoints, and auditability expectations for agent identity creation and role grants. Include concrete, testable acceptance mapping for all ADP-07 criteria. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design explicitly defines AGENT_RUNNER role addition as grantable and backward-compatible with existing role matrix
Reserved username prefix policy for agent: includes actor-based enforcement rules and allowed admin path
Design specifies integration touchpoints across identity registration and role grant paths with clear invariants
Design includes migration/compatibility constraints with no behavior regressions for existing non-agent users
Design includes traceability to ADP-07 acceptance criteria and actionable testability guidance

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-07 agent role and reserved usernames with additive AGENT_RUNNER grant semantics, actor-based agent: username enforcement, compatibility constraints for existing users and roles, and acceptance-mapped testability guidance.
